meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释每条 senpi 提示，让界面功能一目了然
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果使用 senpi 时常想弄懂界面上的每句提示
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth to see what each feature does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often wonder what each tip in senpi means

howto.what: 当用户问起 senpi 界面里的提示(Tip)时,Claude 会先按该用户的设置查出他实际能看到的提示,再对照源码核实机制,最后用提问所用的语言给出有代码出处的深度讲解。
howto.when: 当用户问起 senpi 中的某条提示(Tip)的含义、该提示所指的功能如何运作,或自己能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才那句 Tip: 说失败会自动重试,具体是怎么判断的?
say.note: Claude 会对照源码核实并说明具体的判断机制。

say.text: 我现在能收到哪些提示?哪些被我关掉了?
say.note: Claude 会读取你的设置,列出你实际可见的提示及其原因。

say.text: 被 Fable 5 拒绝后出现的那条提示,背后是怎么运作的?
say.note: Claude 会完整讲解回退到架构师通道的处理流程。

howto.what_en: Asked about a senpi tip, Claude checks the tip list and the user's settings for which tips they can actually see, reads the code behind the feature, then explains the mechanism deeply in the user's language, citing file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks what a senpi tip or Tip: line means, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

say_en.text: That Tip: line said it retries on failure — how is that actually detected?
say_en.note: Claude checks the source code and cites file paths.

say_en.text: Which tips can I currently see, and which ones am I missing?
say_en.note: It reads your settings and lists your visible tips.

say_en.text: What happens behind the tip shown after a Fable 5 refusal?
say_en.note: It walks through the full fallback-architect pipeline.
